bibliographic_identity.title: Tornando possível o impossível: ideias e soluções performativas em algumas obras percussivas de Iannis Xenakis

production_source_extensions.registration_reason: Publisher-hosted scientific article that links author-recorded illustrative media to specific Rebonds B passages and explicit timecoded performance solutions, making a bounded sonic-observation chain possible for analytical listening.

bibliographic_identity.title: Rebonds: Structural Affordances, Negotiation, and Creation

production_source_extensions.registration_reason: Peer-reviewed comparative recording analysis used as methodological support for treating performances as analytical evidence and for separating recorded realization, grouping and structural inference from a purely score-centered account.

locators.section: Comparative recording analysis as analytical entry point
locators.supports: Duinker analyzes ten recorded interpretations across tempo, pitch, accent articulation, grouping and score fidelity, explicitly using performances to reveal aspects that score-centered analysis cannot easily illuminate.

The conclusion treats the ten recordings as evidence for a pluralistic conception of structure and emphasizes that performer decisions can actualize different structural possibilities rather than one fixed performance-derived structure.

source_reviews.rights_and_reuse_note: MTO publisher full text was reviewed for methodological verification. History Go stores only bibliographic identity, paraphrased methodological findings and paragraph locators; MTO text, examples and recordings are not redistributed.

direct_objects.title: Rebonds B — author-recorded illustrative performance examples cited in Labrada, Chaib & Braga Leandro

version_and_identity.recording_responsibility: The Per Musi article explicitly states that the illustrative videos were recorded by the article authors; it does not identify an individual performer for this media object.
version_and_identity.recording_or_performance_date: Exact session date not stated in the reviewed article; the cited media object existed no later than the article submission date 2022-12-09.
version_and_identity.version_or_master: Article-cited YouTube platform object identified by immutable video ID OsEU0xr6bSs; no source-file master, checksum or independent media archive was available in this production.
version_and_identity.format_and_access: Externally hosted YouTube audiovisual stream; accessed through the article's exact video ID and time parameters.
version_and_identity.article_media_role: Illustrative author-recorded examples for discussion of performance solutions; explicitly non-normative.

inspection_chain.article_media_identity: The article repeatedly cites the same YouTube video ID OsEU0xr6bSs for its Rebonds/Okho illustrative examples.

claim_records.statement: I Labrada, Chaib og Braga Leandros artikkelbundne Rebonds B-opptak er alternative drag-løsninger gjort direkte sammenlignbare med tidskoder: artikkelen peker til 00:31 for fire-baquette-eksemplet, 01:00 for den foreslåtte alternerende to-baquette-løsningen og 01:29 for en langsom/rask sammenligning av tidligere løsninger rundt mm. 61–64.
locators: Labrada, Chaib & Braga Leandro 2023, section 2.1, Figure 3 note 8: YouTube OsEU0xr6bSs?t=31
Labrada, Chaib & Braga Leandro 2023, section 2.1, Figure 4 note 10 and Figure 5 note 11: YouTube OsEU0xr6bSs?t=60 and ?t=89; mm. 61–64 comparison

object_scope.passage: section 2.1 / mm. 1–64, with focused comparison around mm. 61–64
object_scope.evidence_role: timecoded audible comparison before broader interpretation

claim_records.uncertainty: The claim is restricted to the article's own mapping between named performance solutions and exact timestamps. History Go has not copied or independently archived the media, does not know the exact recording-session date, and does not treat the examples as a representative sample of Rebonds performance practice.
claim_records.prohibited_inference: The timecoded comparison cannot establish Xenakis's intention, a uniquely correct execution, universal listener segmentation, or the prevalence of any sticking solution beyond the examples discussed in the article.

boundary_records.statement: Labrada, Chaib og Braga Leandro sier eksplisitt at forfatternes videoer er illustrative og at framføringsløsningene ikke har en normerende hensikt; tidskodene dokumenterer konkrete løsninger, ikke én riktig Rebonds-utførelse.
locators: Labrada, Chaib & Braga Leandro 2023, introduction pp. 3–4; author-recorded illustrative videos and non-normative framing
boundary_records.release_effect: Blocks normative wording, intention claims and conversion of an illustrative solution into a canonical performance prescription.

boundary_records.statement: Duinkers comparative recording analysis shows why performance can supply analytical evidence unavailable to a score-only reading, but his ten-recording design also supports a pluralistic rather than singular performance-derived structure.
boundary_records.release_effect: Allows recording-based observation while blocking generalization from this one article-linked object to the work as a whole or to a unique structural reading.

boundary_records.statement: The stable article-to-video identity and timestamps support external inspection, but the exact recording-session date, source-file master/checksum and media reuse license are not independently available; History Go therefore keeps the object external-link-and-metadata-only.
locators: Per Musi article page and PDF: video recorded by authors; exact YouTube ID/timecodes; article CC BY 4.0 does not itself establish the separate hosted media license
boundary_records.release_effect: Blocks copying, extraction, embedding and stronger version/master claims while preserving article-provenanced external inspection.

resolved: The direct object is persistently identified by the article-cited YouTube video ID OsEU0xr6bSs and tied to Rebonds B performance examples recorded by the article authors.
Three exact article-supplied media locators are fixed at 00:31, 01:00 and 01:29, with the 01:29 example explicitly comparing prior sticking solutions slowly and quickly around mm. 61–64.

Rights are conservatively gated: the article is CC BY 4.0, but the separate media license is not resolved, so History Go releases only external-link-and-metadata access and prohibits copying, modification and embedding.

Version/date uncertainty is documented rather than invented: the platform object ID is the released object identity; the exact source-file master and recording-session date remain unavailable and cannot support any chronology- or master-dependent claim.
direct_object_gate.release_rule: Only the timecoded comparison of the article-described Rebonds B performance solutions may drive a question. Preserve the illustrative/non-normative framing, the single-object scope, the absence of intention claims, and external-link-and-metadata-only rights mode.

coverage.known_gap: This production verifies one timecoded Rebonds B analytical-listening chain. It does not cover exact recording-session provenance, media master checksums, comparative listener segmentation, other Rebonds performers, Okho, or broader analytical-listening traditions.
